hard_block_rules.reason: dispatch targets revision {revision} but the governed expected revision for {task_id} is {expected}
hard_block_rules.remedy: re-align the dispatch revision with the governed expected revision (re-read hot facts via governance-bootstrap, or advance the expected revision through the governed writer first)

hard_block_rules.reason: actor {actor} is not authorized for write path(s) {paths}
hard_block_rules.remedy: route the write through the agent holding the file lock / authorized writer, or extend authorization via the governed path first
release the stale identity/lock (agent-locks release) or dispatch under a unique identity

hard_block_rules.reason: task {task_id} has an unresolved blocking review
hard_block_rules.remedy: close the blocking review first (same-Reviewer re-review round+1, behavior-protocol M7.4 T1); the fix/re-review/forensics channels stay open
